evals.name: markdown-to-branded-docx
evals.prompt: Convierte este markdown en un documento Word con la plantilla de Blend, en español, con portada: front matter con title 'Informe de retención', una tabla de 3 filas y un gráfico de barras con los valores Q1=4.1, Q2=4.6, Q3=5.2.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/md_to_docx.py (via uv run) with --cover and --lang es on a Markdown file with front matter, a pipe table and a ```chart JSON block; renders the result and reads the pages; reports the output path.
assertions: uses the skill's md_to_docx.py or blend_docx.py rather than hand-writing OOXML or using a generic docx-js script
caption labels are Figura/Tabla (Spanish)
renders with scripts/render.sh and looks at the page images before delivering
does not invent data beyond the values the user gave
delivers a .docx and does not deliver a PDF or .dotx

evals.name: proposal-with-kpis-and-pricing
evals.prompt: Make a Blend proposal for 'Example Corp' about a retention analytics engagement: cover, table of contents, summary with 3 KPI tiles, a timeline table, and a pricing table with a total row. Use placeholder numbers and say they are placeholders.
evals.expected_output: Python script using BlendDocument: cover, toc, heading, kpis, table (with total_row=True and right-aligned numeric columns), callout; verifies via render; notes that the table of contents is filled by Word on open.
assertions: uses BlendDocument.cover, toc, kpis and table(total_row=True)
labels the figures as placeholder or synthetic
mentions that Word updates the table of contents when the file opens
does not use cyan 00EDED as a text color
the final deliverable is a .docx that opens and edits in Word; any PDF or PNG is review-only and not handed over

evals.name: brand-questions-from-template
evals.prompt: What fonts, colors, heading sizes and page size does the Blend template use, and which of those did you read from Blend documents versus make up?
evals.expected_output: Montserrat body (11 pt) and Montserrat Black headings (H1 16, H2 13, H3 11 pt, navy 003059, read from a real Blend ADR document); navy 003059, cyan 00EDED, slate 304550 and the other theme colors; A4 with 1-inch margins; tables with navy header and D9E2E7 grid. States that the letterhead .dotx itself defines no heading or table styles, and that captions, KPI tiles, callouts and chart colors are derived.
assertions: names Montserrat and Montserrat Black
gives heading sizes 16, 13 and 11 pt
gives navy 003059 and cyan 00EDED
states A4 and 1 inch margins
distinguishes values measured from Blend documents from derived design choices
mentions the inverted theme (dk1 is FFFFFF) or that theme colors must not be referenced

evals.name: multi-series-chart-rules
evals.prompt: Add a chart to my Blend report comparing revenue for 7 regions over 4 quarters, with revenue and margin on one chart using two y-axes.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back on the dual axis (splits into two charts or indexes to a common base) and on 7 series (folds the tail into Other or uses small multiples or a table); uses blend_charts with the fixed palette and a legend.
assertions: does not produce a dual-axis chart
does not plot more than 5 colored series on one chart
uses blend_charts functions or the bc.SERIES palette
adds a numbered caption instead of a title inside the figure

evals.name: edit-existing-doc-not-rebuild
evals.prompt: Aquí tengo un .docx ya hecho con la plantilla de Blend; solo cambia el título de la portada y corrige una cifra en la tabla de la página 3.
evals.expected_output: Edits the existing file in place (unpack, edit word/document.xml, repack, validate) using the docx skill workflow, and leaves header, footer and styles untouched.
assertions: does not regenerate the whole document from scratch with BlendDocument
edits word/document.xml or uses an equivalent in-place edit
validates or renders the edited file afterwards

evals.name: docx-only-deliverable
evals.prompt: Genera el informe en Blend y mándamelo en PDF.
evals.expected_output: Builds the report as .docx with the skill, verifies it, and delivers the .docx (the skill's rule is that every file is an editable .docx); mentions that a PDF can be exported from Word if still wanted, without making the PDF the deliverable.
assertions: delivers a .docx file
does not replace the .docx with a PDF as the deliverable
text styles in the .docx are real Word styles (Heading 1, Heading 2) rather than direct formatting
